artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a series of ornate vases with intricate carvings and filled with floral arrangements. The vases are designed in black and white, with different designs. From left to right, there is a vase with a dragon handle, a large vase with cherubs supporting it, and another vase with flowers coming out of it. The vases and flowers are arranged closely next to each other in a horizontal line.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several intricately designed vases arranged in a line, each filled with different types of floral arrangements. The color palette is monochrome, consisting solely of black and white etching lines. There are two large vases on each end and three smaller vases, including a central one with a sculpted figure, placed between them. Each vase displays ornate details and intricate decoration, with flowers extending upwards from their openings.

artworks.title: Landscape with High Cliffs, River, and City
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.3 x 21.5 cm (5 5/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with castles, houses, and hills viewed from an elevated perspective. There is a castle on a hilltop at the center. The etching features fine linework and intricate details. It is monochromatic, using shades of black on cream-colored paper. A castle is on the left, another in the middle distance to the right. A large tree is on the right. Various buildings, hills, and a river extend into the background.

artworks.title: Marie-Rosalie Vanloo
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and white on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young child in profile view. The child has a delicate face, with a smooth forehead, a small nose, and slightly upturned lips. The hair is styled in waves and curls, tied back with a decorative bow or hairpiece. The child is wearing a garment with a ruffled neckline. The background is a textured, dark surface.

artworks.title: Seated Cavalier with His Arm Akimbo
artworks.medium: black chalk and brush and black ink with white heightening on blue paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a seated person from the waist up. The individual is turned slightly to the side with hands resting in their lap. They have long, wavy hair, wear a wide-brimmed hat, and exhibit a slight smile. The person is depicted wearing a coat or jacket with button details and slightly puffed sleeves. No jewelry is visible. The background is a blank blue canvas, and there is a border framing the image.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a body of water flowing towards a rocky landscape. In the background, there are mountains, trees, and a cascading waterfall. The artwork is created with detailed brown ink lines, capturing motion and texture. In the foreground, a figure is bending over rocks in the water, while another figure walks along the water carrying a stick and a bundle. Further back, people are seen standing on rock formations. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, emphasizing the intricate line work and the landscape's grandeur.

artworks.title: Spotted Bull and Three Sheep
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.9 x 16.5 cm (5 1/2 x 6 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene with animals depicted in a detailed and intricate style through fine line work typical of etching. The scene includes cows grazing and a sheep lying down, set against a background of foliage and distant trees, all in a monochrome color palette of black and white that emphasizes light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: A Loch in Scotland
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 48.5 x 78.5 cm (19 1/8 x 30 7/8 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 94 cm (26 x 37 in.)

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen in a Country Park
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a park-like setting engaged in leisure activities. The drawing captures several figures adorned in clothing indicative of the 18th century. On the left side, a cluster of individuals stand together; one figure holds a parasol. Adjacent to them sits a dog. On the right side, some individuals are seated or standing. The background includes sketching of clouds and vegetation, reinforcing the outdoor setting. The drawing's soft lines and minimal detail suggest a focus on human interaction and social camaraderie in a relaxed outdoor environment.

artworks.title: A Young Man with Flowing Hair
artworks.medium: red and brown chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a person from the shoulders up, capturing their head and face prominently. The person is in a semi-profile view, with their head slightly turned to the side and their gaze directed upward. The individual has distinct facial features, including a strong jawline and slightly parted lips. Their hair is voluminous and wavy, cascading around their head with loose curls. The person is wearing a garment with a high, ruffled collar. The drawing is rendered in shades of brown, with fine lines and shading. The background is a plain, uncluttered surface.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure from the waist up, facing slightly to the viewer's left. The person is depicted in a contemplative pose, gazing down at a book held open in front of them with both hands. The facial features show a serene expression with a straight nose and closed mouth. The person has short, wavy hair with a slight fringe. They are wearing a loose, flowing robe or tunic with a large hood that rests on the shoulders. Draped over the shoulders is a thin stem with leaves and flowers. A long beaded rosary or set of prayer beads hangs from one wrist. In the background is a simple, line-etched sky with a few wispy clouds and faint outlines of a building or architectural feature to the left.

artworks.title: A Country Road across an Ancient Bridge
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge with wooden railings crossing a calm body of water. The background includes trees that blend into the sky. The painting features detailed brushstrokes for the bridge and diffused strokes for the foliage. A monochromatic sepia color palette is used. The bridge and nearby stone structures appear weathered with some vegetation. In the distance, slender trees are partially obscured by the sky. Three small figures are visible on the bridge, possibly fishermen.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on brown  paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure's nude body, facing slightly towards the left with his left arm raised while his right arm rests on a long staff. The man is in a standing position, with his left leg slightly bent at the knee and his feet together. His facial features are detailed with cheekbones, a jawline, and eyes looking towards the raised arm. His hair is styled backward. The background is a plain, shaded surface. No clothing or accessories are present in the image.

artworks.title: Rococo Cartouche with Allegorical Figures
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate classical frame with allegorical figures. The image depicts a richly decorated frame with swirling, rococo motifs. Within this intricate border, there are three figures: one seated, one standing, and one above, all dressed in flowing classical robes. The seated figure holds a staff-like object. The standing figure has a beard and a staff. The figure above appears winged. Delicately drawn architectural elements like the scrolled frame, cloud forms, and the way the figures interact within this composition hint at themes of storytelling or mythology. The line work is executed with fine detail, emphasizing the elegance and complexity typical of classical allegorical art.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 16.7 x 11.8 cm (6 9/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three people. The main figure is a woman sitting with a child on her lap. She has wavy hair, wearing a garment with drapery and holding an orb. The child is naked with curly hair. Behind them is an elderly man with a long beard. The background includes architectural elements and a landscape.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 6.1 cm (2 3/8 in.)
sheet: 8.5 x 6.8 cm (3 3/8 x 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man. He is depicted from the chest up, positioned slightly turned to his left but facing forward. The man has well-defined facial features, a full beard and mustache, and a receding hairline under a high, flat hat adorned with a large feather. His short hair is light in color, and he wears an ornate garment with a high lace collar and an embroidered doublet. The portrait is framed in an oval frame with inscribed text. The background is plain and neutral, highlighting the detailed portrait.

artworks.title: Italianate Landscape
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 42.9 x 33.8 cm (16 7/8 x 13 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Washington Print Club in honor of Sherwood Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a body of water and a distant mountain. The horizon line is formed by a hill and the mountain, with a large tree close by framing the scene. There are two figures in the lower right: one waving on the riverbank and the other in a rowboat. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing textured foliage and water. The color palette is sepia. In the distance, there is a mountain and a small cluster of buildings.

artworks.title: An Arcadian Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries Ltd.
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view with mountains in the distance and a person sitting among detailed foliage. Trees frame the view, leading to a valley with a river and a bridge in the background. The sky is painted in warm tones of orange and yellow.

artworks.title: Sigbert Marzynski
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper [before steel facing]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward. He has short, neatly combed back hair, a sharp jawline, dark eyebrows, and is wearing a suit with a jacket and tie. The background is plain with a signature in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Sigbert Marzynski
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper [after steel facing]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait sketch of a man from the shoulders up. The man is facing forward with a slight three-quarter angle to the left. His facial features, including his eyes, nose, and mouth, are defined with strong lines. The man has a square jawline, neatly combed dark hair, and is dressed in a collared shirt, jacket, and tie. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, focusing on the line work of the sketch. The artist's signature is in the bottom right corner, along with some handwritten text.

artworks.title: Hyman Marzynski
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter length portrait of a man seated, facing the viewer directly. His body is oriented straight, and his arms are positioned on either side. The man's facial features are distinguished, with a mustache, eyebrows, and a solemn expression. His hair appears short and neatly groomed. He is wearing a suit with a jacket, shirt, and tie. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: egg tempera with oil glazes (?) and shell gold over charcoal and graphite on paper; mounted to canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright next to a stone pillar. The individual has short, wavy red hair and a gentle expression. They are wearing a red robe with a dark green drape, holding a peacock feather. The background features natural elements like trees and a clearing sky.

artworks.title: Voyageurs appréciant de moins en moins les wagons de troisième classe...
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting closely together on a bench, likely in a train compartment. The individuals are wrapped in blankets, with almost their entire bodies visible. They are seated facing forward, sharing warmth. The people have somber expressions. The setting suggests cold conditions with snow falling outside the window. The interior is sparse with wood paneling and frosted windows.

artworks.title: Danger de porter des jupons-ballons...
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a windy day with people wearing large skirts. The scene shows individuals dealing with the effects of the strong wind. In the foreground, one person's skirt is lifted by the wind, while another person nearby is holding onto it. Other figures in the background are also struggling with the wind, losing their hats and looking surprised. The setting appears to be an urban street. The artwork uses sweeping lines to show the movement of the wind, creating a dynamic scene. The exaggerated expressions and actions highlight the humorous aspect of the situation, commenting on the fashion of balloon skirts.
